PROJECT REPORT

Women's Health, Personal Hygiene & Menstrual Health Awareness Programme

Project Date: 22nd October 2026

Venue: P.V.D.T. College of Education for Women, SNDT Women's University, Mumbai

Organized By: Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land in association with P.V.D.T. College of Education for Women
Student Attendance: Approximately 70–80 female students

Club President: Rtn. Ramu Gadkar

Project Coordinator: Rtn. Chandra Khona

Guest Speaker: Dr. Kanika Kalyani, Gynecologist & IVF Specialist
College Principal: Dr. Sanjay Shedmake

Project Objective

The Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land organized a special awareness programme on Women's Health, Personal Hygiene and Menstrual Health to educate and empower young women with essential knowledge about reproductive health, menstrual hygiene, preventive healthcare and healthy lifestyle practices.

The programme was conducted under Rotary's theme, "Create Lasting Impact."
